children: Helmerich & Payne expects strong operational and segment results for fiscal fourth quarter 2026, with direct margins for North America Solutions, International Solutions and Offshore Solutions at or near the high end of prior guidance. Activity levels are projected near the high end for North America, near midpoint for International and Offshore, and the company reaffirmed other guidance from its August 5, 2026 release. Management reiterated a constructive outlook for fiscal 2027 and a commitment to reach approximately 1x net debt to adjusted EBITDA by year-end 2027 while maintaining the base dividend.

Company reports expected direct margins for North America Solutions, International Solutions and Offshore Solutions to be at or near the high end of previously issued fiscal Q4 2026 guidance ranges (direct margin is a non‑GAAP metric).
International Solutions direct margin anticipated to be around $45 million for the quarter.
All other financial guidance items from the August 5, 2026 earnings release remain unchanged.
Company reiterated commitment to reach approximately 1x net debt to adjusted EBITDA by calendar year‑end 2027 while maintaining its base dividend.
North America Solutions average rig count expected to be near the high end of prior fiscal Q4 2026 guidance, reflecting robust activity and continued strong commercial trends.
International Solutions average rig count anticipated near the midpoint of guidance, with expected strong growth in Latin America partially offset by near‑term activity reductions in the Middle East.
Offshore Solutions average rig count and management contracts projected to be near the midpoint of the guidance range, demonstrating ongoing consistency in that business.
Management noted ongoing customer discussions and contracting activity across the global portfolio, supporting an expectation of stronger overall direct margins in fiscal 2027 versus 2026.
Company emphasized resilience amid geopolitical volatility, positioning H&P to deliver high‑performance drilling solutions globally.

title: Helmerich & Payne: Q4 FY2026 previews strong direct margins, activity near high end of guidance
